what_happened: The operator stopped the queue drain with drain-stop right after its planning pass and before any job started, so they could choose the first jobs themselves. Athena's plan had three faults. It put the owner's planner request in group 6, behind five groups of older work. It put a stale item, "get main's CI green", in group 1, although main had been green since 15:24. It refused the backlog re-triage because that item had no acceptance. No job ran and no criteria, findings or checks are listed.
cause: The planner orders work by queue age and default rung, and it has no input for the owner's stated priority. It also does not recheck whether an item's premise still holds (main's CI state) before ranking it, and it has no route for items that lack acceptance except refusing them. The drain also runs straight from planning into execution with no point where the operator can review the plan, so stopping it by hand was the only way to override the order.
prevention: Add an owner-priority field to queue items, and make the planner rank by it before age or rung. Have the planner revalidate each item's premise (for example, current CI state of main) and retire or flag stale items before it ranks them. Send items that lack acceptance to a "needs acceptance" list that proposes draft criteria, instead of refusing them silently. Have the drain pause after planning, with the plan visible, until the operator confirms or a configured timeout passes.
proposed_request: Make Athena's queue planner respect the owner's priorities. (1) Let a queue item carry an owner priority, and order the plan by that priority first, then by age. The owner's planner request must come ahead of older default-priority work. (2) Before ranking, recheck each item's premise against current state. An item such as "get main's CI green" must be dropped or marked stale with a reason when main is already green. (3) When an item such as a backlog re-triage has no acceptance criteria, list it in the plan as needing acceptance, with proposed criteria for the owner to confirm, instead of refusing it. (4) Add an option so the drain shows the plan and waits for operator confirmation before starting the first job. Acceptance: with a test queue holding an owner-priority item behind older items, a stale item and an item with no acceptance, the plan puts the owner item first, retires the stale item with a reason, and lists the unaccepted item as needing acceptance with proposed criteria.
